# Bear Carpet Care

> Family-owned carpet, upholstery and oriental rug cleaning company in
> Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, serving Central PA for over 30 years. Non-toxic,
> hypoallergenic, biodegradable products that are safe for children and pets.
> Free quotes, no obligation.

## Key facts

- **Business name:** Bear Carpet Care
- **Location:** Harrisburg, PA 17112, United States
- **Phone:** (717) 454-7347
- **Email:** bearcarpetcarepa@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://bearcarpetcare.com/
- **Ownership:** Family-owned and locally operated
- **Experience:** Over 30 years
- **Service area:** Harrisburg, Carlisle, Hershey, Lancaster, Lebanon and York, PA
- **Hours (ET):** Mon–Fri 8am–7pm, Sat 10am–3pm, Sun 11am–3pm
- **Quotes:** Free, no obligation, usually answered the same business day

## Pricing

Starting prices for standard cleaning. Heavily soiled carpet, stairs, hallways
and rug repairs are quoted separately, and the total is confirmed before work
begins.

- **Carpet, 2 rooms** (up to 250 sq ft): $79.95
- **Carpet, 4 rooms** (up to 500 sq ft): $149.95
- **Sofa:** $79.95
- **Love seat:** $59.95
- **Chair:** $39.95
- **Oriental and area rugs:** 15% off, with free pick-up and delivery

## Services

- [Carpet cleaning](https://bearcarpetcare.com/carpet-cleaning): hot-water
  extraction on wall-to-wall carpet, stairs and hallways; spot and stain removal;
  enzyme pet-odor treatment; sanitizing and deodorizing; Scotchgard protection.
  A room takes 20–30 minutes, a whole home 2–4 hours, and carpet is dry in 6–12
  hours. Recommended every 12–18 months, or 6–12 with pets or children.
- [Upholstery cleaning](https://bearcarpetcare.com/upholstery-cleaning):
  sofas, sectionals, loveseats, armchairs, recliners, ottomans and dining chairs
  in microfiber, cotton, linen, velvet and most blends. A single piece takes
  30–60 minutes, a living room set 2–3 hours, drying 2–6 hours.
- [Oriental and area rug cleaning](https://bearcarpetcare.com/oriental-rug-cleaning):
  Oriental, Persian, Turkish, Indian, Chinese, Karastan, braided, shag,
  machine-made and hand-woven rugs in wool, silk, cotton and synthetic fibers.
  Cleaned off-site at the company facility with free pick-up and delivery,
  usually returned within 5–7 business days. Repairs include reweaving, moth
  damage, fringe repair and replacement, renapping, color retouching, serging,
  binding and size reduction.

## Common questions

- **How much does carpet cleaning cost?** Two rooms (up to 250 sq ft) $79.95;
  four rooms (up to 500 sq ft) $149.95. Stairs, hallways and heavily soiled
  areas are quoted separately.
- **How much does upholstery cleaning cost?** Sofa $79.95, love seat $59.95,
  chair $39.95. Sectionals are quoted by the piece.
- **How often should carpets be cleaned?** Every 12–18 months for most homes;
  every 6–12 months with pets, children or allergies.
- **How long until carpet is dry?** Light foot traffic after 2–4 hours, fully
  dry in 6–12 hours.
- **Are the products safe for pets and children?** Yes. Non-toxic,
  hypoallergenic, biodegradable solutions with no residue left behind.
- **Can pet urine odor be removed?** Yes. Urine spots are located and treated
  with enzymes that neutralize odor at the source rather than masking it.
- **Is rug pick-up free?** Yes, free pick-up and delivery on area and oriental
  rug cleaning in the Harrisburg area; rugs are usually back in 5–7 business days.
- **How do I get a quote?** Call (717) 454-7347 or use the form at
  https://bearcarpetcare.com/contact. Quotes are free with no obligation.
